[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (string: String) (substring: String) : Nat :=
if substring.length = 0 then
  string.length
else
  let n := string.length
  let m := substring.length
  let mut count := 0
  for i in Fin (n - m + 1) :
    if string.drop i.take m = substring then
      count := count + 1
  count
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma drop_take_eq_self
(s: String)
(t: String)
(n: Nat)
(m: Nat)
(h: n < s.length - t.length + 1)
(h_eq: s.drop n.take t.length = t) :
s.drop n = t ++ s.drop (n + t.length)
:=
by
cases s, t
simp [String.drop, String.take]
